text:
tess-sales: CedarBridge wants a joint pilot next month. Scope: Dedicated pool + VPC peering, SAML SSO, and export of anonymized logs to their analytics. Likely healthcare dataset, so security + compliance are gating. Need runbook, security checklist, and two commercial options.

maria-partner: Adding CedarBridge PM (cc). They uploaded a short questionnaire and the SAML XML. Preference is Dedicated but open to Private if we flag PHI.

owen-solutions: Quick: expected monthly tokens? latency SLO? Any constraints on model family?

tess-sales: They estimate ~70M tokens/month and want p95 < 300ms. No strict model requirement but prefer an MPT-class open model.

mina-arch: Infra options: (1) shared dedicated tenant with strict network isolation; (2) isolated tenant in Private. For healthcare data we should recommend isolated tenant + BYOK. Provisioning ballpark for 70M tokens and p95 target -> 2 x A100 equiv with batching. I'll draft provisioning commands and a minimal runbook.

leo-sec: Security checklist: SOC2 summary, dataflow diagram, SAML metadata, KMS/BYOK plan, egress IPs, incident contact, DPA addendum if PHI. I can start prefilling their questionnaire and request clarify on anonymization.

sam-pricing: I'll work up two SKUs: 90-day Dedicated commit and Hosted pay-as-you-go fallback. Need expected SLA and telemetry export volume to size export fees.

maria-partner: CedarBridge security lead is ashley.c@cedarbridge.org. They asked for a one-page runbook and a 30-min prewire call. Can we have runbook + quote by Wed EOD?

mina-arch: Yep, runbook skeleton and network diagram by Wed. I'll include sample commands for redwood provision, saml import, and audit export.

leo-sec: I'll DM Ashley for clarification on data sensitivity and attach SOC2 and redacted dataflow to the questionnaire.

owen-solutions: I'll prepare an eval harness (20 prompt smoke tests) to validate latency and output quality post-deploy.

reminder-bot: Meeting scheduled: Mar 22 09:30 PT - "CedarBridge prewire". Invite sent.

tess-sales: Thanks team. Please react when your task is okay and I'll follow up with CedarBridge for written approval.

maria-partner: :white_check_mark:
